fib30.methodology: Both lanes run the same naive recursive fib(30) algorithm with the measured interval bounded by GO and DONE.

retrying_worker.methodology: Both lanes run 16 deterministic reset cycles totaling 112 loopback HTTP requests and 288 ms of scheduled retry delay.

tasks_10000.methodology: Both lanes create, join, verify, and clean up 10,000 short-lived tasks; the checksum is the sum of task indexes.

tcp_fanout.methodology: Both lanes pre-bind 20 ephemeral loopback listeners before READY, then fan out 20 clients to 20 owning server tasks with a 100 ms handler delay. Aura cannot transfer an accepted TcpStream to a handler task because host resources are non-Transfer (AU3008), so a one-listener shape would serialize the handlers and is deliberately not measured.
